description: This Java class implements a servlet filter (SeoContentUrlFilter) that intercepts HTTP requests to handle SEO-friendly content URLs by mapping them to internal content IDs and forwarding requests accordingly within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SeoContentUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that processes incoming HTTP requests to handle SEO-friendly URLs for content in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that intercepts HTTP requests, extracts URL info, queries content data, and forwards requests based on SEO URL mappings.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service.
